title: Correct Analogies
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the analogies between thermal quantities and electrical quantities.

title: Heat Conduction Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct heat conduction equation from the analogy and conservation law.

title: Rate of Heat Loss
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the rate of heat loss through the pipe.

title: Temperature Distribution
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for temperature distribution between the inner and outer radii.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly state the boundary conditions used in the temperature distribution derivation.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors in the equations derived.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
